Enum Class EventCategory

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<EventCategory>
york.studentevents.events.EventCategory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<EventCategory>, Constable
public enum EventCategory extends Enum<EventCategory>
Categories available for classifying student events on the York Student Events platform.
